provenance.driver: Playwright launching the system Chrome with no locale, userAgent or extraHTTPHeaders option, so no header is installed through DevTools; Accept-Language comes from //net
provenance.action: a same-origin page that set probe_sid=abc123: a link click (navigation), a click on a <form method="post"> submit button (application/x-www-form-urlencoded, one field), and a page fetch() (GET, and POST with Content-Type: application/json); every first request is answered with the named redirect status to a same-origin target
